svg.title: Retatrutide vs Ozempic 2 mg in type 2 diabetes, 80 weeks
svg.desc: Retatrutide vs Ozempic 2 mg in type 2 diabetes, 80 weeks. Weight change: Retatrutide 9 mg -19.5% (-20.1 kg); Retatrutide 12 mg -20.9% (-21.5 kg); Ozempic 2 mg -9.4% (-9.5 kg). A1C change: Retatrutide 9 mg -2.2 points; Retatrutide 12 mg -2.2 points; Ozempic 2 mg -1.8 points. Efficacy estimand, open-label trial funded by Eli Lilly.
